The exchange rate is 2 old records → 1 new record.  
The five customers leave with a total of 7 new records.  
Each new record requires exactly two old records, so the total number of old records they must have handed in is  

\[
7 \text{ new records} \times 2 \frac{\text{old}}{\text{new}} = 14 \text{ old records}.
\]

The fact that there are five people does not affect the calculation; it only tells us the group size.

**Final answer: 14**
